difficulty_reason: H2 is supported by the retained character-elimination core in Propositions4.1–4.3, not by venue or terminology. After the cited confining/action correspondence, the authors still construct a sharp disjoint-bump splitting of F_n, use bounded generation by disjoint fixators to eliminate multi-coordinate characters, build two endpoint-crossing elements in an arbitrary confining subset, and handle three support-position cases to obtain the uniform Q^7 bound for interior characters; endpoint sign cases require a separate Q^3 argument. This is then combined with the retained join construction and character-kernel order comparison to obtain the full global poset. These nonroutine dynamical/algebraic constructions are included, not assumed as external prerequisites.

compared.result: Quadratic Dehn function for the circle group T; a filling inequality, not classification of the interval groups F_n cobounded hyperbolic actions.
Amenable étale groupoid implies Borel-amenable equivalence relation; a measure/groupoid claim, not the hyperbolic-action poset.
Obstruction to tree-pair representation for algebraic Bieri–Strebel groups; different objects and conclusion from F_n confining-subset elimination.
Embedding a subgroup into a Brin–Thompson group; no hyperbolic-action classification.
Von Neumann algebra L(F) boundary-support lemma for relative invariant subalgebras; not a classification of cobounded hyperbolic actions.
No-holding trace of a Schreier random walk as a reversible tree kernel; stochastic boundary data, not all cobounded hyperbolic actions.
Positive definite virtual-link/quandle function on V; different group and invariant.
Finite-window Cayley-graph retention/density optimization; not the coarse-equivariant domination poset or character elimination.
